items.title: Why Is GE Vernova (GEV) A Key Pick For Queensland's Supernode Battery Project?
items.summary: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) has been selected as a key technology partner for stage three of the Queensland Supernode BESS grid scale battery project in Australia. The contract centers on advanced grid connectivity and large scale battery energy storage systems for the Queensland power network. The project has secured Generator Performance Standards acceptance, a major regulatory step for connecting to the Australian grid.
